scene_timeline.visual_description: The creator presents the finished medium-rare ribeye steak topped with mushroom sauce alongside a cheesy baked potato. They cut into the steak and use the potato skin as a taco shell to scoop up the sauce.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Upbeat hip-hop music plays throughout the video.

scene_timeline.visual_description: A tray of raw ingredients is shown, followed by a whole potato being placed into a Ninja air fryer.
The creator sears the ribeye in a stainless steel pan, adding butter, garlic cloves, and rosemary to baste the meat.
scene_timeline.audio_description: Sizzling sounds are audible over the music.

scene_timeline.visual_description: The mushroom sauce is prepared by sautéing shallots and sliced mushrooms, then adding garlic, black pepper, salt, butter, heavy cream, and chopped parsley.
The baked potato is sliced open, mashed with butter and pepper, topped with cheese, and briefly returned to the air fryer before final plating.

parsed_output.overall_summary: This video is a fast-paced cooking tutorial for a medium-rare ribeye steak served with a rich mushroom cream sauce and a cheesy baked potato. The creator demonstrates air-frying the potato for a crispy skin, pan-searing and basting the steak with aromatics, and preparing a homemade mushroom sauce from scratch. The final presentation shows the potato skin being used as a 'taco' to hold the steak and sauce, emphasizing a decadent and comforting meal.

people.description: The creator's hands are visible throughout the video as they prepare and plate the food.

takeaways.statement: Air frying a potato at 200c for 45 minutes creates a skin crispy enough to be used as a taco shell.
Basting steak with butter, garlic, and rosemary in a pan is the preferred method for achieving a high-quality sear and flavor.

items.name: Air Fried Baked Potato
items.details: Oil and heavily salt the outside; air fry at 200c for 45 minutes uncovered. Mash inside with butter, pepper, and cheese.

items.name: Mushroom Sauce
items.details: 250g mushrooms, 1/2 shallot, 2 cloves garlic, 2 tbsp butter, heavy cream (to cover), salt, black pepper, handful of parsley.

items.name: Ribeye Steak
items.details: Pan-seared and basted with butter, garlic, and rosemary until medium-rare.
